name: Summer Temptations
source:
You and your adventurous girlfriend Aria stumble into some dark secrets... You know little of what was going on around you your whole life until this very moment...

As the story unfolds, you find yourself torn between humility and unexplored desires, while Aria, your playful and adventurous girlfriend, gently encourages you to open up to new experiences.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你与热爱冒险的女友艾莉娅无意间撞破了一些阴暗的秘密……直到这一刻之前，你对自己一生中周围究竟发生着什么几乎一无所知……

随着故事层层展开，你发现自己在矜持克制与未曾涉足的欲望之间摇摆挣扎，而俏皮又大胆的女友艾莉娅则温柔地鼓励你敞开心扉，去拥抱全新的体验。

[摘自Itch.io]
